This article is about DLC related to Minecraft Dungeons. For DLC related to Minecraft Dungeons II, see Dungeons II:Downloadable content.

The term downloadable content, also known as DLC, refers to content beyond the scope of the base game that provides additional content for the player’s hero. DLCs can range from a collection of cosmetics to a few extra missions.
